names.note: Name page 9284 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Василий (Аменицкий), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the genitive «Василия пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, and a Cyrillic grep for «Амениц» over every `saint.json` returned nothing — the bare «Василий» is a fold this form stays clear of.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 августа ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Василия пресвитера (1938).»

attestations.note: The day's fifteenth and last entry, and a separate one from the company of eight before it, which closes «(1937)». THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind his name. The line says «пресвитера» and name page 9284 «протоиерей», archpriest, so `presbyter` and the office `Archpriest` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*amenits*` was empty. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
